role: Interface of one entity's instance of an attribute: base value, modifier set and the cached computed value.

members.name: getAttribute
members.note: the instance identifies its attribute by the enum field which, not by an IAttribute reference

members.name: func_111122_c
members.note: the flat mods[ATTR_MAX_MODS] array stands for the collection; no per-operation sets, and ATTR_MAX_MODS caps it at 8

members.name: getModifier
members.note: no standalone by-UUID lookup; the duplicate check inside attrs_apply/remove is the only UUID comparison

members.name: applyModifier
members.note: attrs_apply's duplicate guard is the Java IllegalArgumentException for an already-applied UUID

members.name: removeModifier
members.note: removes every UUID match from the flat list, equivalent to Java's removal from the three maps

notes: Interface only in Java; native folds it into struct attr_instance (living.h:70) plus the attrs_* functions in living.c. The interface's func_111122_c name is the SRG spelling kept in the source; no MCP name exists for it. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): interface, marker or abstract base; its behavior lives in the subclasses' ports.
